text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- By-elections in Ben Arous and Medenine; results expected on Monday.
- Saharan International Festival of Douz from December 26-29.
- Prime Minister Karoui starts three-day visit to Jordan where he will chair with Jordanian Prime Minister Kabariti second session of cooperation commission.
- Close cooperation in education, culture, and information between Libya and Tunisia.
